four_direct_orientations.nibble_swap: reverse each two-symbol byte token, order intact

astra_prior_scope.prefix_alignment_audit: Audits grouped decoder phase after prefix cuts, not visible token-order reversal.
astra_prior_scope.reviewed_exact_raw_five_token_order_tran: No implementation was found in the pinned selected ASTRA sources; this is a bounded source-corpus statement, not a global/private-history absence claim.
astra_prior_scope.visible_group_octal: The pinned 32-cell probe tests left/right placement of one two-symbol ragged group and reverses the serialized octal character stream; it does not apply raw five-token-order reversal.

formatting_inference.conditional: If an unformatted 1092-symbol string was first grouped left-to-right in width five and a later operation moved whole output tokens or all characters in reverse order, either reversal moves the short final token to the front.
formatting_inference.fact: 1092=218*5+2 and the preserved display has a leading two-symbol token.
formatting_inference.not_proved: The token lengths alone do not prove any reversal occurred: original right-aligned/manual grouping or already-spaced source text also yields a leading short token; and the lengths cannot distinguish full-character from whole-token reversal.

proof_effects.interpretation: Prior results remain valid for their four named orientations; a fifth token-order input lies outside them rather than invalidating them.
preserved_without_target_rerun: Any theorem stated for every input sequence remains algebraically valid.
Global hexadecimal symbol histogram and distinct-symbol cardinality are invariant under token permutation.
requires_new_input_certificates: Direct Bifid pair histograms, typed graphs, SMT formulas and their saved exclusions depend on symbol positions.
Pairing hex symbols into bytes changes under a five-token permutation because five is odd; exact byte-bag, periodic-residue and CFB constraints depend on the resulting byte sequence.

question: Does RA or accepted ASTRA coverage establish or test visible five-token-order reversal for Rev7?

controls: Synthetic 2+5+5 token fixture distinguishing G from full reversal and four direct orientations.
Round-trip token-order reversal and exact preservation of 1092 symbols/token lengths.
A planted direct Bifid fixture evaluated under G and inverted exactly.
recommendation.first_step: Implement one source-defined operation G on the preserved 219 display tokens: reverse token order, retain token interiors, join, and assert its hash differs from all four direct orientations. Do not use RA sweep --pre reverse_words until its compact-before-pre wiring is fixed or bypassed.
recommendation.limits: This tests one formatting transform at one direct layer. It does not justify RA tier-3 expansion, infer historical use, or invalidate earlier cells.
recommendation.smallest_new_experiment: Run G as one additional input through the accepted direct Bifid certificate pipeline: even-period pair-cardinality/rectangle filters, then odd typed-graph and coupled-join filters only for residuals. This reuses input-independent proofs but recomputes input-dependent certificates and avoids a broad modern-cipher sweep.

semantics.consequence: For Rev7 sweep input, reverse_words and stripws+reverse_words are identity-pre duplicates; neither reverses visible group order.
semantics.node_reverse_words: split on ASCII-whitespace runs, reverse tokens, join with one ASCII space
semantics.raw_composition: On whitespace-bearing raw text, stripws+reverse_words (left-to-right) equals stripws, not the original raw text.
semantics.sweep_actual_input: run separately compacts Target.raw; Ctx.stage applies Pre to that compact buffer, despite comments calling it raw text
semantics.target_loader: load_target preserves ciphertext in Target.raw and infers display from a whitespace-compacted copy
semantics.toolfmt: Applied after initial display decoding, immediately before modern decrypt; it does not restore the discarded visible grouping to --pre.
